title: Task Manager font size doesn't update immediately when system font size changes
line: Task Manager labels and other Plasma text now switch to the new size as soon as the system font size is changed.
explanation: Plasma's panels and popups are plain Qt Quick windows, which never push a changed application font to items that already exist, so every Label kept the font it was created with and only newly created ones (like a new task) got the new size. Plasma's Kirigami theme also set its default and small fonts once at creation and never refreshed them. The theme now refreshes both fonts when the application font changes, and Plasma's Label binds its font to the theme's default font, as the desktop style's Label already does.

commits.message:
plasmacomponents3: make Label follow system font changes

Labels in Plasma kept the font they were created with, because Plasma
windows don't propagate font changes to existing items and the Plasma
theme never refreshed its fonts. Refresh them and bind Label to them.

BUG: 480004
